case_number: 2025 INSC 135; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (SLP (C) NO.24893 OF 2018)
summary: Irretrievable breakdown of marriage acknowledged; husband remarried, parties cohabited briefly, no will to reconcile; divorce decree upheld without re-examining cruelty findings; maintenance dispute unresolved due to conflicting income claims; one-time settlement attempted via mediation but failed; Rajnesh v. Neha and Kiran Jyot Maini cited for maintenance factors; remand for maintenance determination based on verified income/asset affidavits.
legal_provisions_cited: Kiran Jyot Maini v. Anish Pramod Patel
final_judgment: Divorce decree upheld; matter remanded to family court for determination of maintenance based on verified income and asset affidavits; one-time settlement not achieved.
